segments.prompt: 她把队伍的单子和一包货一起放上柜台

options.label: 让她坐一会儿
options.label_en: Tell her to sit a while

segments.prompt_en: She sets the squad's list and a bundle of goods on the counter

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 帆布包先压上柜台，包底带下的灰落下来，两张价签歪到一边。
lines.en: A bulging canvas bag lands on the counter first, knocking two price tags askew.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 包不用看。先看这个。
lines.en: Forget the bag. Look at this first.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 把一张叠了好几折的纸拍在柜台正中间队里的单子。
lines.en: Presses a sheet, folded several times, onto the middle of the counterThe unit's list.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 止血、退烧、消毒。再往下是枪和子弹。
lines.en: Stuff to stop bleeding, fever meds, antiseptic. Below that, guns and ammo.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 字写歪了，你凑合看。
lines.en: I wrote it. It's a bit crooked. Make do.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你写的。
lines.en: You wrote it.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 嗯。对单子、采买、出货，现在都归我。
lines.en: Mm. Checking lists, buying, selling. That's all on me now.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我进了革命军。以后队里要的药和枪，先过我手。
lines.en: I joined the Revolution. From now on, the unit's meds and guns go through my hands.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 别拿那种眼神扫我。衣服是他们发的。
lines.en: Don't look at me like that. They issued me these clothes.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 拽了拽袖口肩线多出来两指。谁裁的不知道，手艺够绝。
lines.en: Tugs at her cuffThe shoulders are two fingers too wide. Whoever cut this is a real genius.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 以前在上面的衣服，裁缝都得来量够三回。
lines.en: Up there, a tailor came to measure me three times for one outfit.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 现在能套进身上就行。
lines.en: Now, if I can get it on, it's good enough.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 穿这身从街上过，有人冲地上吐口水，也有人偷往我手里塞半颗营养果。
lines.en: Walking the streets in this, some people spit on the ground. Some slip me half a Nutrifruit.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 今天不拿单子上的货，钱不够。
lines.en: I'm not taking anything on the list today. Not enough money.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 先卖这包。换成信用点，过两天我拿着单子来取。
lines.en: Selling first. Turn this bag into credits. I'll come back for the list in a couple days.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 货的来路，别问。
lines.en: Don't ask where this came from.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 问了也白问。
lines.en: I wouldn't tell you anyway.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你这店本来就没只收干净货吧？
lines.en: Your shop never only took clean goods anyway, right?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 队里现在缺什么？
lines.en: What's the unit short on?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 单子上有，自己看。不认字？
lines.en: It's on the list. Can't you read?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……都缺。止血的最缺，有人伤了，没东西压。
lines.en: ...Everything. Stuff to stop bleeding most of all. People get hurt and we've got nothing to press on it.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 朝窗口外那把椅子抬了抬下巴坐。
lines.en: Points to the chair outside the windowSit.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 不坐。坐下我就起不来了。
lines.en: No. If I sit, I won't want to get up.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 手指在椅背碰一下，缩回去先看货。
lines.en: Rests a hand on the chair back, then pulls it awayGoods first.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 把那张纸展平，压在柜台边上先看货。
lines.en: Smooths out the list and pins it at the counter's edgeLet's see the goods.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 扯开包口的绳结都是旧货，成色有好的也有坏的。
lines.en: Unties the canvas bag's cordAll old stuff. Condition varies.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 有两件撞出了口子，我查过。
lines.en: Two pieces are chipped. I checked them myself.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 手探进包里，停住
lines.en: Reaches into the bag, then stops

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 前几天，治安部的人叫我去认。
lines.en: A few days ago, Security called me in to identify someone.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 认出来了。
lines.en: I recognized her.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她死了。我去认过尸。
lines.en: She's dead. I identified the body.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 头发短了。是在里面剪的吧，我也说不清。
lines.en: Her hair was cut short. Done inside, I guess. I never knew.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 一张纸递过来，让我在最底下签名。
lines.en: They handed me a paper and had me sign at the very bottom.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 签完字第二天，研究就公开了。
lines.en: The day after I signed, the research went public.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 营养果那份。现在满站都是，经过就能看见。
lines.en: The Nutrifruit one. It's posted all over the station now. Anyone walking by can take a look.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她攒了半辈子的东西。
lines.en: Half her life's work.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 好了，就这些。
lines.en: There. I'm done.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 嗯。
lines.en: Mm.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你就一个“嗯”？
lines.en: That's it? Just "mm"?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 连“节哀”都省了。
lines.en: Not even a "sorry for your loss."

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……也好。这几天听得够够的。
lines.en: ...Fine. I've heard that one enough lately.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 包里的东西一件件摆出来，码在柜台
lines.en: Takes items out of the bag one by one and lines them up on the counter

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 队里有人让我把上层那几件衣服一起带出来，说料子能多换点药。
lines.en: Someone in the squad told me to bring my Upper Level clothes too. Said Upper Level fabric trades for more medicine.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我没带。那几件怎么处置，我定。
lines.en: I didn't bring them. Whether I keep those is my call.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 其余的都在柜上。
lines.en: The rest is all here.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 按成色开价。别凑整，别多给。
lines.en: Price it by condition. Don't round up, and don't overpay.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 行，这个价我接。
lines.en: Fine. I'll take that number.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 把空包折起来，塞进背心口袋过两天我拿单子来取。
lines.en: Folds the empty bag and tucks it into her vest pocketI'll be back in a couple days with the list.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 钱给多了。别当没这回事。
lines.en: You overpaid. Don't pretend you didn't.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 队里急用，先收。账我记下了，谢你谈不上。
lines.en: The squad needs it, so I'll take it this time. I'll remember this. Don't expect a thank-you.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你压价压得真狠。
lines.en: That's a pretty brutal price.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我讲过，给少了就装回去。……今天队里等不了，算你走运。
lines.en: I said I'd take it back if it was low. ...The squad can't wait today. Lucky you.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 下次我先去别家问清楚价钱再来。
lines.en: Next time I'll check other shops' prices before coming here.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 谈不拢，散。
lines.en: If we can't agree, forget it.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 把柜上的东西一件件收回包里我换家店。单子你记着，说不定还用得上。
lines.en: Stuffs the items back into the bag one by oneI'll try another shop. Keep the list in mind. You might need it.

segments.prompt: 她把单子推过来，等着拿货
segments.prompt_en: She slides the list over and waits for the goods

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 背包瘪瘪地挂在她肩上，帽檐上积着一层灰。
lines.en: A deflated backpack hangs from her shoulder. Her cap brim is coated in dust.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 喂，没打烊吧。
lines.en: Hey. Still open?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 上次那包旧货卖的钱，我一张没少带回来。
lines.en: The money from that bag of old stuff last time? I brought it back untouched.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 单子重摊开，折痕边起了毛
lines.en: Spreads the list out again, its creases worn fuzzySame list.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 昨晚动了一行。退烧的，提到最上面。
lines.en: Changed one line last night. Fever meds moved to the top.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 队里有人发热？
lines.en: Someone's running a fever?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 伤口发起来了。
lines.en: His wound got infected.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 他年纪比我小，昨天还追着我问上层长什么样。
lines.en: He's younger than me. Yesterday he asked me what the Upper Level looks like.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 胳膊上一道口子拖了三天，昨天开始说胡话。
lines.en: A gash on his arm. Left it three days. Started raving yesterday.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 翻来覆去喊一个名，队里没这个人。
lines.en: He keeps calling a name. Nobody in the squad goes by it.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 后半夜来人换我，我才去躺了会儿。
lines.en: I sat with him past midnight. Only lay down when someone took over.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 消毒那瓶，上回就该买。
lines.en: That bottle of antiseptic. Should've bought it last time.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我原想先把旧货换成现钱，再一块取，账好算。
lines.en: I figured I'd turn the old stock into cash first, then buy it all at once. Cleaner books.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 他因此多熬了两天。
lines.en: He waited two extra days because of that.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 把单子拽过来下半截呢？
lines.en: Turns the list around And the bottom half?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 枪，子弹。领头那人画了两个圈。
lines.en: Guns, ammo. The leader circled them twice.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 钱只够买一头。
lines.en: There's only enough money for one.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 单子在我手里。药先拿，枪下回。
lines.en: The list's in my hands now. Medicine first, guns next time.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 把单子下半截折起来，按在手掌下
lines.en: Folds the bottom half of the list and pins it under her palm

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 照单子把货一行行摆到柜台上
lines.en: Lays the goods on the counter, line by line, following the list

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 退烧那栏，你眼睛多停了一下。
lines.en: You looked twice at the fever line.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 对，照这个次序走。
lines.en: Right. Do it in that order.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 下回什么时候来？
lines.en: When's your next visit?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 看那家伙退不退烧。
lines.en: Depends on whether his fever breaks.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 退了，我来取枪。没退，也得来。
lines.en: If it breaks, I'll come for the guns. If it doesn't... I'll still have to come.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 侧过身子让出台面你自己挑。
lines.en: Steps aside to leave the counter clearPick for yourself.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……你倒不怕我把好的几样全挑了？
lines.en: ...Aren't you worried I'll take all the best stuff?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 行，你自己说的，别反悔。
lines.en: Fine. Your call. Don't regret it.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 没等他招呼，自己弯下腰翻下层的货架，一样样拿起来看
lines.en: Leans toward the lower shelf, turning items over one by one

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这卷绷带边发黄了，受过潮吧。
lines.en: The edges of this bandage roll are yellowed. Got damp, didn't it?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 煮一遍还能使。我们那儿没那么多讲究。
lines.en: Boil it once and it's usable. We're not that picky out there.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 呵。放以前听见这话，我得把杯子摔了。
lines.en: Heh. The old me would've smashed a cup hearing that.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 血袋要是有，拿给我看一眼。
lines.en: If you've got blood bags, let me take a look.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 退烧的放最上，消毒的摞一起。
lines.en: Fever meds on top. Stack the antiseptic together.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 绷带我自己数，你别碰。
lines.en: I'll count the bandages myself. Hands off.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 价钱照你平时的来。
lines.en: Charge your usual prices.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这是队里的钱。你让一分，我回去说不清。
lines.en: It's the squad's money. Knock off even one credit and I can't account for it.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 队里再要什么，我都到你这儿拿。
lines.en: From now on, whatever the squad needs, I'll buy here.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 别家的账，我不信。
lines.en: I don't trust anyone else's books.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 算吧。换班前我得赶回去。
lines.en: Ring it up. I need to be back before the shift change.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 没等他问，按说好的顺序把药往背包里塞一样不差。
lines.en: Packs the medicine into her bag in the order she gave Nothing missing.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 今晚就用得上。
lines.en: We can use it tonight.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 走了。下回来拿单子下半截。
lines.en: I'm off. Next time I'll come for the bottom half of the list.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你又少算了。说过别让。
lines.en: You undercharged again. I told you not to cut me slack.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……行。这笔记在我这儿，下回一块对。
lines.en: ...Fine. I'm keeping track of this. We'll square it next time.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 背上包，从窗口退开，停了一下走了。
lines.en: Shoulders her bag and steps away from the window, then pausesI'm off.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 比我估的贵。
lines.en: Pricier than I thought.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我不跟你吵，那边人还烧着。
lines.en: I'm not arguing. Someone back there's still running a fever.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 账我记下了，下回一条条对。
lines.en: I've noted the tab. Next time we go over it line by line.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 拿不下来。
lines.en: I can't afford it.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 把单子折好，收回胸口袋我去别家问问。都不成，再回你这里。
lines.en: Folds the list and tucks it back into her chest pocketI'll ask around. If nobody can, I'll come back.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 冷风从窗口灌进来，柜台上多了一张边角起毛的单子。
lines.en: A cold gust blows through the window as the frayed list is slapped down in the middle of the counter.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 上次欠的半截，今天结清。
lines.en: Here to cover the half I owed last time.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 只要枪和子弹，其余不看。
lines.en: Guns, ammo. Nothing else.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 把单子翻到背面药没写？
lines.en: Turns the list over to check the backMedicine?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那边药还顶着。
lines.en: We have enough.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 退烧那盒管用，烧已经退了。
lines.en: That box of fever reducers worked. The fever broke.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 早上他自己端碗，还嫌营养果没味。
lines.en: The kid held his own bowl this morning. Complained the Nutrifruit's bland.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 哼，还能挑嘴，就没事。
lines.en: Heh. If he's got the strength to be picky, he'll live.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 这单子比上次短。
lines.en: The list's short.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你眼真毒。
lines.en: ...Sharp eyes.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 指腹压住单子顶端划黑的那条我涂黑的。
lines.en: Presses a fingertip on the blacked-out bar at the topI crossed this one out.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那行原是要买护膝的带子，给他的。
lines.en: It said bandages for a knee. For one person.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那人不用了。
lines.en: He won't need them now.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 知道了。
lines.en: Mm.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 前天夜里他们四个一块儿出去的，就他没回来。
lines.en: The four of them went out together the night before last. He was the only one who didn't come back.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 第二天清早给抬回来的。
lines.en: They carried him in the next morning.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 别问，我不在当场，只听人讲了一半。
lines.en: Don't ask how. I only heard secondhand. Not the whole story.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那天我留在房里盘账。
lines.en: I was inside that day, balancing the books.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你划得挺重。
lines.en: You pressed hard.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 笔不顺手。
lines.en: Bad pen.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……第一次没涂住，又压了两回。
lines.en: ...The first stroke didn't take. I went over it twice more.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 领头的说，再没枪，下回得折更多人。
lines.en: The squad leader says without guns, next time we'll lose more than one.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这次我不跟他吵。
lines.en: This time I didn't argue.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 从怀里掏出个布包，搁在单子边上钱全在这。
lines.en: Pulls a cloth bundle from an inner pocket and sets it beside the listAll the money's here.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 旧货剩的，加队里凑的。
lines.en: What's left from fencing the old stuff, plus what the unit scraped together.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 能用的摆出来。磨狠的、卡壳的，别拿。
lines.en: Show me what works. Nothing worn down, nothing that jams.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 枪我不懂。队里人教装弹，我两次装反。
lines.en: I don't know guns. Someone in the squad taught me to load. I did it backwards twice.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你乐什么。……没乐？那省事。
lines.en: What's funny? ...You're not laughing? Good.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 枪哪里不行，当着我面讲。
lines.en: If one's got a problem, tell me to my face.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 会讲。
lines.en: I will.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 子弹按盒算，散的别糊弄。
lines.en: Ammo by the box. Don't fob me off with loose rounds.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 回去我守着他们一颗颗数。
lines.en: I'm going back to count them out for them, one by one.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 价钱也别给我让。
lines.en: And no discounts.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 把那张纸推到台面正中就这些，店主。
lines.en: Pushes the list to the middle of the counterGo on, shopkeeper.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 枪的毛病你讲过，钱数也合得上。
lines.en: You told me which ones have problems, and the price adds up.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 把子弹盒一个个塞进布包回去我再数。差一发，我回头寻你。
lines.en: Stacks the ammo boxes into a cloth bag one by oneI'll count them back there. One short, and I'm coming for you.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这回家伙算补齐了。
lines.en: This time the guns actually made it.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 停，这数不对。你往里搭钱了。
lines.en: Hey, this number's wrong. You gave me a discount.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 说好了别给我让价的。
lines.en: I said I wouldn't take one.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……这次先带走。下回拿消毒的货，多出的从那里抵。
lines.en: ...Fine, I'll take it for now. Next time I buy antiseptic, take it out of that.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 比我想的价钱高出不少。
lines.en: That's a good chunk higher than I figured.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 成，我接了。队里拖不得。
lines.en: Fine, I'll take it. The squad can't wait.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 下次还这样，我去别家拿货。
lines.en: Pull this again and I'll ask somewhere else.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 一支能用的都没有？还是就不愿给我？
lines.en: Nothing that works? Or you just won't sell to me?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 把单子叠好，收回怀里成，我去别处找。
lines.en: Folds the list and tucks it back into her inner pocketFine. I'll ask elsewhere.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 领头的跟前，我担着。
lines.en: I'll explain it to the leadership myself.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她停在窗口外，没往近处靠。
lines.en: She stops outside the window and keeps her distance.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 今天没有单子带给你，别往我身上扫。
lines.en: Quit looking. No list today.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我不过是打这儿过。
lines.en: Just passing by.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 出什么事了？
lines.en: What's wrong?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 张嘴就问这句，你跟队里那些人一个路子。
lines.en: That's the first thing you ask. You're just like them.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 没等你开口，她把窗边那把椅子拖到窗下摆正别问，先让我坐下。
lines.en: Pulls the chair closer to the window herselfDon't ask. Let me sit.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 仍低头理着架子上的绷带
lines.en: Keeps sorting the bandages on the shelf, head down

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……喂，你真打算一句话都不给？
lines.en: ...Hey, you're just going to leave me standing there?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 行，那正好。椅子我先借了。
lines.en: Fine. Maybe that's better. Lend me the chair.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 朝窗边那把椅子抬抬下巴坐吧。
lines.en: Points to the chair outsideSit.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 把椅子抵住墙才坐下，双手搁在膝上这椅子一腿长一腿短。
lines.en: Braces the chair against the wall before sitting, hands in her lapThe legs are uneven.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 它一直就这样。
lines.en: Always have been.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 呵，那你就由着它？
lines.en: Heh. And you never fixed it.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 晃就晃吧。队里没椅子，都坐木箱上。
lines.en: Let it wobble. We don't have chairs back there. We sit on crates.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 配给站对面那间房我退了，现在跟他们挤一屋。
lines.en: I gave up my room across from the ration station. Now we all bunk in together.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 今天屋里的人在清点那个人的物件。
lines.en: Today they were clearing out his things.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 外套一件，鞋一双，铁盒一个。
lines.en: A coat, a pair of shoes, a tin box.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 有人拎着外套说还能穿，问谁要。
lines.en: Someone said the coat was still wearable. Asked who wanted it.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 没人应。后来有人说，那就拿去换药。
lines.en: Nobody said a word. Then someone said, trade it for medicine.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 接着全朝我看。往外换什么，向来我说了算。
lines.en: Then they all looked at me. Trading is my job.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我让他们明天再论，自己先出了门。
lines.en: I said we'd deal with it tomorrow, and walked out.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 从前在上边，心里一烦，我就躲去母亲的花房。
lines.en: Up top, when things got to me, I'd go to Mother's greenhouse.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 架子一排排，水声不住，灯通宵点着。
lines.en: Rows of racks, water always running, lights on all night.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 掌心对搓两下，朝指缝里哈了哈气你这里比队里暖。
lines.en: Rubs her hands together, breathes into themIt's warmer here than at our place.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我搬走那天，室友哭着把她那条旧毯子塞给我。早知道就拿了。
lines.en: The day I moved out, my roommate was crying and trying to press her old blanket on me. Wish I'd taken it.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我再坐一小会儿。
lines.en: I'll sit a while longer.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 椅子轻响了一下，换班的铃从巷子那头飘过来。
lines.en: The chair creaks now and then. A shift-change bell rings in the distance down the alley.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 起身，把椅子推回窗边得走了。
lines.en: Stands and pushes the chair back beside the window I've got to go.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 走出两步，又回头看一眼椅子椅腿真该垫垫，你记着。
lines.en: Takes two steps away, then looks back at the chairYou really should prop up that chair leg.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 还是我。
lines.en: Me again.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这把椅子我自个儿拽，手别伸。
lines.en: I'll drag the chair myself. Don't get up.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 坐下，从背心口袋掏出张四折的纸队里的花名册。发药分饭都照它。
lines.en: Sits, pulls a paper folded in quarters from her vest pocketThe unit roster. Medicine, food, it all goes by this.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我誊了三份。墙上贴一份，领头的拿一份，我自己收着一份。
lines.en: I copied it. Three copies. One on the wall, one for the squad leader, one for me.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 第七行空出来了。
lines.en: Line seven is empty now.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 墙边那张叫人划了。我这张没动。
lines.en: Someone crossed it out on the wall copy. Mine, I didn't.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 又从另一边贴袋摸出张糖纸，铺在膝盖上用手掌捋平
lines.en: Pulls out another crumpled candy wrapper and slowly smooths it flat on her knee

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那个铁盒里，满当的是这些。
lines.en: That tin box was full of these.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那人是谁？
lines.en: Who was he?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 名不报了。说你也对不上人，我还懒得再念。
lines.en: I won't say his name. You wouldn't know it, and I don't want to say it again.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 缺什么？
lines.en: What do you need?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 呵，我要的，你这里可没货。
lines.en: Heh. What I need, you don't sell.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 倒了半杯热水，搁她面前的柜面边沿
lines.en: Pours a cup of hot water and sets it on the counter by her hand

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 手指没沾杯把，先把那杯热水往台面中间推了推你倒是耐得住。
lines.en: Runs a finger once around the rim, doesn't pick it upYou're a patient one.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……他左腿膝盖不行，一变天就疼。
lines.en: ...His knee was bad. The left one. Hurt whenever it clouded over.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 上楼得扒墙走，下楼比上楼还磨蹭。谁喊他快点，他回头就吼。
lines.en: Used the wall going upstairs, slower going down. Anyone rushed him, he cussed them out.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 领药总站最后一个，说排前头的比他等不了。
lines.en: Always last in line for meds. Said the people ahead needed it more.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 取完药就含一颗糖，糖纸捋平，塞进那个铁盒。
lines.en: After his meds, he'd suck on a candy, smooth the wrapper, and put it in the box.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我们那儿根本没糖。不知道他哪里搞来的。
lines.en: Where would we even get candy? No idea where he found it.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 他说等盒子装满，就带上头换一顿饭。
lines.en: He said once the box was full, he'd trade it to someone Upper Level for a meal.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我跟他说了，上面没人收糖纸。
lines.en: I told him nobody up there wants candy wrappers.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 他就说，那给你，反正你从上层来。
lines.en: He said then he'd trade them to me. I came from the Upper Level.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 呵，那东西给我做什么。
lines.en: Heh. What would I want with that junk?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 到走也没满，差一小截。
lines.en: The box never filled. Short by a good bit.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 绑带那事他找过我几回，我全给排后面去了。
lines.en: He asked me about the bandages a few times. I kept pushing them back.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 买完药还得先买枪，他要的绑带就一直往后拖。
lines.en: Meds first, then guns, bandages last.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 顺序我定的。
lines.en: I made that call.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那晚，绑带没派上用场。
lines.en: That night, bandages wouldn't have helped.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我懂！不用你插嘴……
lines.en: I know! I don't need you to...

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……是，没派上。
lines.en: ...Right. They wouldn't have.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我管单子，盯账本，还跟你压价。
lines.en: I run orders, balance the books, haggle with you.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 人往外跑了，我留守在房里数子弹。
lines.en: They go out. I stay in and count bullets.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 离了跑单子这一样，我手里还剩别的吗？
lines.en: Besides running orders, what else have I got?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 别接。我不是问你。
lines.en: Don't answer. I wasn't asking you.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 第七行，你留着没划。
lines.en: Line seven. You didn't cross it out.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 嗯。没动。
lines.en: Yeah. I didn't.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 把糖纸折成小方块，往名单里一夹就这么留。空着不补。
lines.en: Folds the candy wrapper into a small square and tucks it into the listIt stays like that. Blank is fine.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 外衣我收着。下次带来，跟你换消毒水。
lines.en: I kept the coat. Next time I'll bring it here and trade it for antiseptic.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你那张椅子，现在稳了。
lines.en: This chair of yours doesn't wobble anymore.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 垫过。
lines.en: Shimmed it.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 弓身扫了扫椅脚呵，垫的啥？没用的标价纸？
lines.en: Bends down to look at the chair legHeh. With what? Old price tags?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 行。比队里那些收木箱强。
lines.en: Fine. Beats the crates back at our place.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 起身，名单塞回背心口袋，顺带把窗页推小了些到点了，我回队。
lines.en: Stands up and presses the list back into her tactical vest pocketShift change. I'm heading back.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 明天发药，我得在边上清数。
lines.en: Meds get handed out tomorrow. I have to stand there and count.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 脚挪开一步，手还留在窗框上……下回没单子，我照来。
lines.en: Steps back, her hand still on the window frame...Next time I'll come even without a list.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 别问为啥。
lines.en: Don't ask why.

segments.prompt: 她站在窗外，外套搭在胳膊上，一直没坐
segments.prompt_en: She stands outside the window, coat over her arm, still not sitting.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 窗上的卷帘没拉起来，外头有人敲，力气很轻，隔一会儿才响下一声。
lines.en: The window shutter is still down. Someone taps on it softly, one knock at a time.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你醒了？我原先还当你睡着。
lines.en: You're open? I figured you weren't up yet.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 别去翻钟。我也知道这一趟太早。
lines.en: Don't look at the clock. I know it's early.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 胳膊上搭着件外衣，没往你跟前递，也没撂到旁边手里没单子，也没有要出的货。
lines.en: A coat hangs over her arm. She doesn't hold it out, doesn't put it downNo list, no goods.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我开枪打死了人。
lines.en: I killed someone.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 昨晚，后半夜。
lines.en: Last night, a few hours before dawn.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 别这么看我。
lines.en: Don't look at me like that.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 在营房里，这话我对着墙练了半宿，到底张不开嘴。
lines.en: Back home, I couldn't get the words out.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 朝她身后、窗边那把椅子抬了抬下巴先坐。
lines.en: Points to the chair behind her, beside the windowSit.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我先站着把话说完。现在坐下，后头就续不上了。
lines.en: I'll finish standing. Then I'll sit.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 外衣甩上椅背，手扶住椅背顶，人还直挺挺站着木头冰手。
lines.en: Drapes the coat over the chair back, hand on it, but doesn't sitThe chair's cold.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你闻这股冲味儿，沾的是火药。我搓了一回，没褪掉。
lines.en: You can smell that on it, right? Gunpowder. It didn't scrub out.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 倒了杯开水，放在柜台边上
lines.en: Pours a cup of hot water and sets it at the edge of the counter

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 外衣撇到柜台另一头，再两手去捧杯子，热水晃出来打湿了指根谁让你倒这么满。
lines.en: Tosses the coat on the counter and lifts the cup with both hands; a little water sloshes outWhy fill it so full?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 半杯才合我的手。这会儿端什么都要洒。
lines.en: Half a cup's enough. My hands aren't steady.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那件衣服你也别上手，火药气还熏着呢。
lines.en: Don't touch the coat. It reeks of gunpowder.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 伸手把她小臂上那件外衣拿过来给我。
lines.en: Reaches over and takes the coat off her armGive it here.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.en: Hey...

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 两手把外衣对折一下，才松开劲拿就拿吧，叠过一道，省得味儿扑你满脸。
lines.en: Fine, take it. It smells.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 沾的是火药。我蘸水搓过，干透了仍然有。
lines.en: Gunpowder. I scrubbed it with water once. It didn't come out.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 两只手空下来没处摆，末了攥住战术背心的下摆你挂到远点的地方。
lines.en: Her hands are empty now. She doesn't know where to put them, and finally grips the hem of her tactical vestHang it somewhere far.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我挂远些。
lines.en: I'll hang it out of the way.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 行。
lines.en: Fine.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这趟我带出去一个，队里年纪最小的。
lines.en: I took someone out with me. The youngest in the unit.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 领头的把人交给我，叫我看住他，我应了。
lines.en: The squad leader told me to watch him. I said okay.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 对面先抬的枪，瞄着他开的。
lines.en: They fired first. At him.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 他跟我并排，就在左边，离不到一肘远。
lines.en: He was right on my left. Less than an arm's length away.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我没经想，枪已经叫响了。
lines.en: I raised my gun and pulled the trigger. Didn't think at all.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 就我这么个会把子弹装倒的人，那一下却稳得没边。
lines.en: Me. The one who loads rounds in backwards. My hand didn't shake once.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 再倒回去，我还照扣。他今早还有劲嫌饭没热透。
lines.en: I'd do it again. He still had the energy to gripe about cold food this morning.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 就是……
lines.en: It's just…

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 枪口冒出来一根烟，很细，直直立着往上走。
lines.en: A wisp of smoke came off the muzzle. Thin. Going straight up.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 对面早就没动静了，那根烟还在一截一截地升。
lines.en: The other side had gone quiet long before. That smoke kept rising.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 眼一合，就是那根烟。
lines.en: Every time I close my eyes, it's that smoke.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 店里只开了靠柜台的那排灯，窗外那把椅子已经摆在墙根，正朝着她常坐的方向。
lines.en: Only half the shop lights are on. The chair outside the window is already in her usual spot.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这回我敲门下了力气，你总该听见了吧。
lines.en: Knocked hard this time. You heard that, right?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 朝窗外那把椅子扫过去一眼 你早就把它放好了？
lines.en: Looks at the chair outside the windowYou already put it there?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 昨天夜里就没往屋里收。
lines.en: Never put it back last night.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你倒是料得挺死。
lines.en: Hah. You called it.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 坐下去，手指勾着拉链往下拽了半寸，又一点点推回去 先讲清楚，今天照样没单子。
lines.en: Sits, unzips her tactical vest partway, then zips it back upJust so you know, no list today either.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 倒好热水推到她手边，又弯下腰从柜台下头摸出半块面包
lines.en: Pours a cup of hot water and slides it over, then takes half a loaf of bread from under the counter

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你拿这个出来干什么？
lines.en: What's this?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 面包，我的早点。
lines.en: Bread. My breakfast.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 捏掉一小角塞进嘴里，腮帮子动得慢 干。
lines.en: Breaks off a small piece and chews slowly A bit dry.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 总比营养果好下口。这话别让队里听见，不然有人眼红。
lines.en: Still beats Nutrifruit. Don't spread that around, or the unit'll get jealous.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 两只手包住杯子，水面在杯口下头一晃一晃 还抖，比前天轻。
lines.en: Holds the cup in both hands; the water keeps trembling Still shaking. Better than two days ago.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 昨晚一闭眼，就看见那根烟。
lines.en: Last night, when I closed my eyes, that smoke was still there.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 只是烟短了些，飘到半路就散开。
lines.en: It just wasn't as long. It broke up halfway.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我盯着那点烟消下去，后来就迷糊过去一阵。
lines.en: I watched it break up, and somewhere in there, I slept a little.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 迷糊了多久？
lines.en: How long?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 天没透亮就睁眼，撑得住。
lines.en: Woke before dawn. It's enough.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我来过这儿，别让队里知道。早上的那几趟，尤其不能提。
lines.en: Don't tell the unit I've been here. Especially not these early mornings.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 队里现在觉着我稳，说下次还叫我带。
lines.en: They look at me like a squad leader now. Say I'm steady. Want me leading again next time.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 要是他们撞见，我连杯水都端得晃，这差事就给别人了。
lines.en: If they knew I can't even hold a cup of water steady, they wouldn't let me.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我不说。
lines.en: I won't.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 早上那个小的问我，眼睛怎么红了。
lines.en: The kid asked me this morning why my eyes were red.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我让他把鞋带先系牢，上回带子松着就往出跑。
lines.en: I told him to tie his own laces first. Last time he ran out with them loose.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 现在看见我，头一低就瞄鞋。活该。
lines.en: Now he stares at his shoes whenever he sees me. Heh. Serves him right.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 把最后那点面包团进掌心，站起来 留到路上吃。
lines.en: Closes her hand around the last of the bread and stands I'll eat this on the way.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 得走了，今天还要数子弹。
lines.en: I should go. Still have ammo to count today.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她把杯子推回柜台里侧
lines.en: She slides the cup back to the shopkeeper's side of the counter.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 下回别等开门。
lines.en: Next time, don't wait for opening.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……谁应了你还有下回。
lines.en: ...Who said there's a next time?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 人朝窗子转过去，手指还搭在窗框上，没回头 外面那地方，凉。
lines.en: Turns to leave, her hand still on the window frame, without looking backThat ground out here is cold.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 随你吧。
lines.en: Do what you want with that.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 那人肩上扛着一捆用粗绳扎紧的东西，到窗边就卸到地上，斜靠在墙根。
lines.en: The visitor carries a tightly bound bundle on his shoulder, then sets it against the outside wall beside the window.

lines.speaker: RevQuartermaster
lines.text: 这店铺是你开的？
lines.en: You the one running this shop?

lines.speaker: RevQuartermaster
lines.text: 我在队里管仓库。以前来跟你对单的人出门了，这些日子换我来跑。
lines.en: I keep the unit's stores. The one who usually checks lists with you is out, so I'm making the runs for now.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她人呢？
lines.en: Where is she?

lines.speaker: RevQuartermaster
lines.text: 随大队出发了，前两天没亮就动身。
lines.en: Went with the main force. Left before dawn, two days ago.

lines.speaker: RevQuartermaster
lines.text: 说大概十天。顺不顺，路上没个准。
lines.en: Ten days, give or take. Whether the road goes smooth, nobody can promise.

lines.speaker: RevQuartermaster
lines.text: 他把捆绳松开，把东西在地上铺开。库里剩下的料，人少了，用不上，还占着地方。
lines.en: Unties the rope and spreads the bundle on the floorMaterials piled up in storage. Most of our people left, so we can't use them. They just take up space.

lines.speaker: RevQuartermaster
lines.text: 留在这的几张嘴得吃饭，队里就按低价放。别嫌，也别乱琢磨。
lines.en: The few of us left behind still need to eat, so the price is low. Don't complain, and don't read into it.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 是她叫你来的？
lines.en: She sent you?

lines.speaker: RevQuartermaster
lines.text: 走前一晚交代的。
lines.en: Told me the night before she left.

lines.speaker: RevQuartermaster
lines.text: 她原话是，那家报价格不转弯，别跟人磨，磨也占不到便宜。
lines.en: Her exact words: that shop quotes straight. Don't haggle. You won't win.

lines.speaker: RevQuartermaster
lines.text: 他抓了抓后脑。我到现在还没弄懂，这句算夸你还是笑我。
lines.en: Scratches the back of his headI still can't tell if that was praise for you or a dig at me.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 都算。
lines.en: Both.

lines.speaker: RevQuartermaster
lines.text: 临出门前一晚，她一个包一个包翻开看。
lines.en: The night before we moved out, she opened every single pack.

lines.speaker: RevQuartermaster
lines.text: 绷带几卷，消毒水几瓶，子弹按人头拨，她拿着单子一样样对。
lines.en: Rolls of bandages, bottles of antiseptic, ammo split per head. She read the list item by item.

lines.speaker: RevQuartermaster
lines.text: 有人嫌麻烦，说差不多就成。
lines.en: Someone got fed up and said that was good enough.

lines.speaker: RevQuartermaster
lines.text: 她站到那人面前，不出声，就等他再把包打开。
lines.en: She just stood in front of him without a word until he opened his pack himself.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 开了？
lines.en: Did he?

lines.speaker: RevQuartermaster
lines.text: 开了，真就差一卷绷带。
lines.en: He did. One roll of bandages short.

lines.speaker: RevQuartermaster
lines.text: 那人后来没言语，蹲在墙根把包重新捆了一遍。
lines.en: Not a word from him after that. He crouched in the corner and repacked the whole thing.

lines.speaker: RevQuartermaster
lines.text: 顶小的那个，鞋带被她查了三遍。
lines.en: The youngest one? She checked his shoelaces three times.

lines.speaker: RevQuartermaster
lines.text: 他低头揪了揪自己的鞋带。得系成死扣。她讲一跑散开，就别跟在她后面。
lines.en: Looks down and tugs at his own lacesDouble knots. She said if they come loose on the run, don't bother following her.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她自己的包呢？
lines.en: And her own pack?

lines.speaker: RevQuartermaster
lines.text: 比我的沉。药一多半在她身上，她说放别人那里不放心。
lines.en: Heavier than mine. She carried most of the medicine. Said she didn't trust anyone else with it.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 嗯。
lines.en: Mm.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 先看货。
lines.en: Goods first.

lines.speaker: RevQuartermaster
lines.text: 是该看。我回去还得给守着的几个熬汤。
lines.en: Fair. I still have to cook a pot of soup for the ones left behind.

lines.speaker: RevQuartermaster
lines.text: 他提起一头抖了两下。这捆受过潮，已经晾过，不碍事。成色你自个瞧。
lines.en: Picks up a length and shakes it outThis bundle got damp, but it's dried out. No harm done. Judge the quality yourself.

lines.speaker: RevQuartermaster
lines.text: 这些全是她走前点过数的，短一件你来问我。
lines.en: She counted all of this before she left. Anything missing, come find me.

lines.speaker: RevQuartermaster
lines.text: 他把材料往台边推了推。都摆这了，你挑。
lines.en: Pushes the materials toward the counterThat's all of it. Take your pick.

lines.speaker: RevQuartermaster
lines.text: 价是队里定的。你还要压，我回头照实报给她。
lines.en: The unit set the price. If you want to go lower, I'll have to report that to her as is.

lines.speaker: RevQuartermaster
lines.text: 就按这数，和她讲的一样，不跟你绕。
lines.en: That's the number. Just like she said. Straight.

lines.speaker: RevQuartermaster
lines.text: 把绳子一圈圈绕在手上。夜里汤能多下两把料了。
lines.en: Winds the rope around his hand and stows itThat's two more handfuls in the soup.

lines.speaker: RevQuartermaster
lines.text: 你多给了。
lines.en: You gave too much.

lines.speaker: RevQuartermaster
lines.text: 我收下，不过回头她对单子问，你自个去跟她交代。
lines.en: I'll take it. But when she checks the list and asks, you explain it to her.

lines.speaker: RevQuartermaster
lines.text: ……行，我磨不过，她早就讲明了。
lines.en: ...Fine. Can't out-haggle you. She warned me.

lines.speaker: RevQuartermaster
lines.text: 这数我原样报给她，她回来要怎么说，我不担。
lines.en: I'll pass that number on to her as is. What she says when she's back isn't my problem.

lines.speaker: RevQuartermaster
lines.text: 不要就拉倒，我扛回去。
lines.en: Fine, forget it. I'll haul it back.

lines.speaker: RevQuartermaster
lines.text: 重新把材料扎牢，甩上肩。等她回来，你俩当面谈吧。
lines.en: Reties the bundle of materials and swings it onto his shoulderShe can deal with you herself when she's back.

segments.prompt: 战士说完，弯腰去提地上的包
segments.prompt_en: Done talking, the fighter bends to pick up the bag

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 那人走到窗口时，裤腿上已经干成一层泥壳。他先把肩上的包摘下来放在地上，喘了好一会儿。
lines.en: With dried mud caked on his trousers, the visitor reaches the window, drops his pack to the ground, and catches his breath.

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: 店主，我手上有点货，你收不收？
lines.en: Shopkeeper, you buying?

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: 路上得的，队里叫先带回来换点钱。
lines.en: We took it on the road. The squad sent me back first to sell it.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 都什么。
lines.en: What is it.

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: 几把枪，再就是些零碎子弹。
lines.en: Guns, a few. Plus some loose rounds.

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: 把包口掀开一条缝，低头往里看了看，又按回去对面扔的，没坏。
lines.en: Pulls the pack open, glances inside, closes itThe other side dropped them. Not damaged.

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: 走到半路崴了脚，撵不上队，领头的就让我带货先撤回来。
lines.en: I twisted my ankle and couldn't keep up, so the squad leader had me bring these back on my way.

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: 去的时候走了五天，回来我磨了一天半。
lines.en: Five days out, a day and a half limping back.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 队上呢？
lines.en: And the squad?

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: 一直没停，还在往前赶。
lines.en: Still pushing forward.

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: 前头有段路塌了，只留一条窄口，还得等天黑再摸过去。
lines.en: A stretch of the route collapsed. Only one narrow path left to walk, and we had to cross at night.

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: 领头的去前头看路，后面那五个，由埃莉诺一路领过来。
lines.en: The squad leader scouted up front. Eleanor brought the back five across.

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: 她隔几步就回头数人，一个一个念出声。
lines.en: Every few steps she'd stop and do a headcount, muttering the numbers.

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: 她把那小的系在自己左边，一步都不让落下。
lines.en: She kept the youngest tied to her left side. Not half a step away.

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: 等过了那段再点，全在。
lines.en: We counted on the other side. Nobody missing.

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: 我脚刚崴，她就解开我的包，分了一半过去自己背。
lines.en: My ankle had just gone. She came over, split my pack, and hung half of it on herself.

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: 我拦了一句，她只回，别废话，跟上。
lines.en: I said she didn't have to. She said, "Shut up and keep up."

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 把货摆出来。
lines.en: Show me the goods.

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: 把包搁上柜台，按住一角我脚有点疼。借这儿靠一会儿。
lines.en: He rests the pack on the counter and holds a corner. My foot's sore. Let me lean here a minute.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她会回来。
lines.en: She'll be back.

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: 你倒真不慌。
lines.en: You sound pretty sure.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 人是她带走的，就得她原样带回来。
lines.en: The people she takes out, she brings back herself.

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: ……过窄道前，她也这么说过，一个字不差。
lines.en: ...She said that at the mouth of the path. Word for word.

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: 对了，还有一桩。我往回走那天，她单独把我叫到边上。
lines.en: Oh, one more thing. The day I headed back, she pulled me aside.

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: 叫我路过这店铺，替她瞧一眼门板还开不开。
lines.en: Said if I passed this shop on the way, check if it's still open.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 开着。
lines.en: It is.

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: 她让捎句话，她的杯子你别给收了。
lines.en: She told me to tell you: don't put her cup away.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 没收。
lines.en: I haven't.

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: 把包口掀开你看，这些值多少？
lines.en: He opens the pack. What'll you give me for the lot?

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: 她也留了话，价照老样子算，别在你这儿抹眼泪。
lines.en: She said normal prices, and no playing pitiful in front of you.

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: 这些够队里用几天。
lines.en: That'll keep the unit going a while.

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: 把空包卷成一卷塞到腋下我先回去歇脚，她回来前得会走路。
lines.en: Rolls up the empty bag and tucks it under one armI'm going back to rest my foot. I need to be walking before she's back.

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: 多出来的这份，我记她单子上，算你的。
lines.en: The extra, I'll mark on her list. I'll say it was your call.

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: 回头她发火，别拉上我。
lines.en: If she yells, don't pin it on me.

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: 这价……行吧，反正是路上白拿的，没本钱。
lines.en: That price... fine. We picked it up on the road. Didn't cost us anything.

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: 她要问，我照实学。
lines.en: If she asks, I'll tell her straight.

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: 你要不收，我还背回去。
lines.en: Not buying? Then I'll haul it back.

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: 把包甩到背上，一瘸一拐地离了窗口等她回来了，让她自己找你说。
lines.en: Swings the pack onto his back and limps away from the windowWhen she gets back, let her talk to you herself.

lines.speaker: RevFighter
lines.text: 那小孩鞋带老散。她蹲下去替他系，嘴里还数落他。
lines.en: That kid's laces kept coming undone. She got down to tie them for him, scolding him the whole time.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 来人停在窗口跟前，气还喘不匀，手里拎着旧衣裹成的长包。
lines.en: The visitor is still panting when he reaches the window, carrying a long bundle wrapped in old clothes.

lines.speaker: RevGuerrilla
lines.text: 店里有人没？我天不亮就动了，一路没停脚。
lines.en: Shopkeeper here? I left early. Didn't stop once.

lines.speaker: RevGuerrilla
lines.text: 我打前站先回来。后头的人落我一天多。
lines.en: I came ahead to scout. The main group's a day and change behind me.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 全回来了？
lines.en: Everyone?

lines.speaker: RevGuerrilla
lines.text: 全回来了，一个不缺。
lines.en: Everyone. Not one missing.

lines.speaker: RevGuerrilla
lines.text: 窗口那把椅子你摆的？我差一点就坐上去了。
lines.en: Did you put that chair beside the window? I nearly plopped down on it.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 没打算给你。
lines.en: It's not for you.

lines.speaker: RevGuerrilla
lines.text: ……那行，我站这儿。
lines.en: ...Right. I'll stand.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她在哪？
lines.en: Where is she?

lines.speaker: RevGuerrilla
lines.text: 埃莉诺？最后头压阵。
lines.en: Eleanor? Bringing up the rear.

lines.speaker: RevGuerrilla
lines.text: 末尾那段她自己要走的。谁落下，她扭头就能瞧见。
lines.en: She insisted on walking last that final stretch. Anyone falls behind, she sees it.

lines.speaker: RevGuerrilla
lines.text: 说邪了你别不认。往回这一路，最小的那孩子一回都没掉过队。
lines.en: Believe it or not, the whole way back, the youngest never fell behind once.

lines.speaker: RevGuerrilla
lines.text: 他想掉也不行。她后边一喊名，那孩子两条腿就快了。
lines.en: Couldn't if he tried. She calls his name from the back and his legs speed right up.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她伤着没？
lines.en: Is she okay?

lines.speaker: RevGuerrilla
lines.text: 胳膊刮了一道。
lines.en: Got a cut on her arm.

lines.speaker: RevGuerrilla
lines.text: 过矮墙时让铁皮边擦的，不深。
lines.en: Caught it on sheet metal climbing a low wall. Not deep.

lines.speaker: RevGuerrilla
lines.text: 绷带她自己裹的。管药的要帮忙，她说药留给用得着的人。
lines.en: Wrapped the bandages herself. Our medic offered to look. She said save it for someone who needs it.

lines.speaker: RevGuerrilla
lines.text: 她嘱咐我别在队里说，怕大家知道了分神。
lines.en: She told me not to mention it to the unit. Said it'd distract everyone.

lines.speaker: RevGuerrilla
lines.text: 揉了揉鼻头可你又不算队里的，说给你，不叫我嘴漏。
lines.en: Rubs nose But you're not in the squad, so telling you doesn't count as loose lips.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 算。
lines.en: It counts.

lines.speaker: RevGuerrilla
lines.text: ……那回头她问，别讲是我漏的。
lines.en: ...Then don't tell her you heard it from me.

lines.speaker: RevGuerrilla
lines.text: 她托我捎句话。
lines.en: Right, she asked me to pass along a message.

lines.speaker: RevGuerrilla
lines.text: 让店主给她留根能量棒。
lines.en: She says to save an energy bar for her.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 小意思。
lines.en: Can do.

lines.speaker: RevGuerrilla
lines.text: 大队明天到，最迟后天。她估的脚程，一般没差。
lines.en: Main unit arrives tomorrow, day after at the latest. Her words, and her words usually hold.

lines.speaker: RevGuerrilla
lines.text: 她胳膊那伤，见了别先提。她不乐意听。
lines.en: That cut on her arm, don't ask about it to her face. She hates that.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 嗯。
lines.en: Mm.

lines.speaker: RevGuerrilla
lines.text: 掀开旧衣，里头的东西一样样往柜台上放道上拾的，刀，还有几件抡起来使的硬家伙。
lines.en: Unwraps the old clothes and sets the contents on the counter one by oneFound them on the road. A blade, and a few things for smashing stuff.

lines.speaker: RevGuerrilla
lines.text: 全是对面扔下的。东西不精，但压手，砍起来不卷刃。
lines.en: All dropped by the other side. Not great, but heavy. Edges won't roll on a chop.

lines.speaker: RevGuerrilla
lines.text: 她扫过一眼，说别跟你讲虚的，你认得成色。
lines.en: She took a look. Said you know quality, so don't try sweet-talking you.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 递上来。
lines.en: Bring them up.

lines.speaker: RevGuerrilla
lines.text: 把东西码上柜台，两手拍灰你自己瞧，我还得赶回营里送信，留守的都等着呢。
lines.en: Lines them up on the counter, dusts off hands Have a look. I've gotta get back and report. The ones holding the fort are waiting.

lines.speaker: RevGuerrilla
lines.text: 行嘞，我回营把数报上。
lines.en: Deal. I'll go report, and bring the numbers too.

lines.speaker: RevGuerrilla
lines.text: 旧衣叠好揣进怀里那椅子我连边都没沾。
lines.en: Folds the old shirt and tucks it away And I never touched the chair.

lines.speaker: RevGuerrilla
lines.text: 给多了？那我不推，营里缺的正是这些。
lines.en: Too much? I won't argue. The ones holding the fort need it.

lines.speaker: RevGuerrilla
lines.text: 回头她回来一盘，数目错了别赖我。
lines.en: If her books don't add up when she's back, that's on you.

lines.speaker: RevGuerrilla
lines.text: 啧，还不如我估的数。
lines.en: Tch. Less than I figured.

lines.speaker: RevGuerrilla
lines.text: 算了，她早说过你识货，你说多少就多少。
lines.en: Fine. She said you know quality, so that's the quality.

lines.speaker: RevGuerrilla
lines.text: 不要？那成，我提回去。
lines.en: Don't want them? Fine, I'll haul them back.

lines.speaker: RevGuerrilla
lines.text: 东西重新包进旧衣反正她这一两天就到，你俩当面计较。
lines.en: Wraps everything back in the old shirt She'll be here in a day or two anyway. Settle it with her face to face.

segments.prompt: 她站在门外，手还扶着椅背，没往里走

options.label: 说门一直留着
options.label_en: Say the door was always open.

options.label: 问她伤要不要紧
options.label_en: Ask if her wounds are serious.

segments.prompt_en: She stands outside, hand still on the chair back, not stepping in.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 卷帘升到一半，埃莉诺就坐在窗下那把椅子里，腿上按着一张叠起的纸。
lines.en: As the window shutter rises, Eleanor comes into view on the chair outside, a folded sheet of paper on her knees.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……你挺会挑点开门。
lines.en: ...You're right on time opening that door.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 没起身，抬脸看那扇往上收的窗这回没敲，半下都没给。
lines.en: Still seated, looks up at the rising shutterI didn't knock. Not once this time.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 坐多长时间了？
lines.en: How long?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 没看。来那会儿外头还没亮。
lines.en: No idea. It was still dark when I sat down.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 椅面潮得很，我拿袖子抹了两下。
lines.en: There was dew on the chair. I wiped it off with my sleeve.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 胳膊。
lines.en: Your arm.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 左臂往身后收了半寸划了一下，已经收口，不碍事。
lines.en: Tucks her left arm behind her backA cut. It's scabbed over. It's nothing.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 少看。带子是我自己上的，比你绑得平。
lines.en: Stop staring. I wrapped the bandages myself. Neater than you would.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 腿上那张纸摊开，又照旧折上名册。昨晚进了屋，我挨个念过去。
lines.en: Unfolds the paper on her knee, then folds it back along the creasesThe list. When we got in last night, I read it off name by name.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 没缺。那孩子也点到了，鞋绳还系成死扣。
lines.en: All there. The kid too. Shoelaces still in a dead knot.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 里头第七排还空着，我没写新的。
lines.en: Line seven's still blank. I didn't add anyone.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 值夜那会儿，我数上头那几盏灯。数没了就猜，这钟点你该上锁了。
lines.en: On night watch, I counted the lights up above. Then I'd think: about now, you'd be locking up.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 昨晚点完名，回去躺了一会儿。
lines.en: After roll call last night I went back and lay down for a bit.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 怎么都睡不着。
lines.en: Couldn't stay down.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 到窗底下，见这椅子还搁外头。
lines.en: I came to the window and saw this chair outside.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……你一直没搬进去？
lines.en: ...You never brought it in?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 没收。
lines.en: Never did.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 扶着椅背起身，身子偏了一下，又立稳你可真是。
lines.en: Pushes herself up by the chair back, sways, then steadiesYou.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我没动过地方。
lines.en: I've been here all along.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 抬起眼看窗口里的他，名册揣进背心兜里
lines.en: Looks up at the shopkeeper inside the window and puts the roster in her vest pocket

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 椅子也一直搁着。
lines.en: The chair too.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 胳膊伸来。
lines.en: Let me see your arm.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 左臂递上前，袖管卷起一截，没抽回去
lines.en: Holds out her left arm and pushes the sleeve up a little, not pulling it back

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 放平，我重新给你裹。
lines.en: Put your arm on the counter. I'll rewrap it.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我好想你。
lines.en: I missed you.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她把椅子朝窗边拖近一点，重新落座，左胳膊压在柜台上。
lines.en: She pulls the chair a little closer to the window, sits down, and rests her arm on the counter.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 店主把台面上几样杂物移开，给她空出一块地方。
lines.en: The shopkeeper moves the clutter on the counter aside to make room for her.
